## About

Dogs R Us Collingwood offers little dog daycare in Collingwood, Ontario for dogs 18″ (paw-to-back) or under. Proudly serving Collingwood, Ontario — including Blue Mountain, Wasaga Beach, Clearview and Thornbury. Puppy daycare is available from 4 months with required vaccines. Every dog needs a Meet & Greet and a signed waiver before daycare.

## Service area

- Collingwood, Ontario
- Blue Mountain / The Blue Mountains
- Wasaga Beach
- Clearview
- Thornbury
- Grey County / Georgian Bay area

## Services

- Little dog daycare in Collingwood — full day $50, half day $30 (up to 5 hrs), shoppers special $20 (up to 3 hrs); +HST
- Dog boarding in Collingwood — little dogs only — $75 +HST / 24 hours (includes a full daycare day)
- Treats R Us — house-made dehydrated single-ingredient treats; shipping available

## Booking

No online booking forms. Call or text Tracie at 705-606-4145. Documents: waiver and policy PDFs linked from the site FAQ.
